mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates and boosts valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals coordinated monetary easing and labor market strength, compressing equity discount rates and boosting corporate hiring to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a decline in housing starts signals weakening demand and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and HOUST declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production and real GDP growth indicates robust economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO and GDPC1 both rise, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly payroll gain exceeding 100,000 jobs signals continued labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 100000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
